description: This file defines the EmpContract entity class for managing employment contract extensions in the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database columns, encapsulates contract-related data such as start and end dates, and establishes a relationship with the Employee entity.

classes.name: EmpContract
classes.description: Represents an employment contract extension linked to an employee, including contract dates and identifiers, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this contract.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this contract.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the contract extension.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the contract extension.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the contract extension.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the contract extension.
